notes: Authored 2026-09-30 before the implementation. A Latin word joined by a hyphen or an apostrophe and absent from the lexicon is read part by part in Korean speech: the hyphen and apostrophe are silent, a final 's is 스 (docs/latin-joiners.ko.md). Whole-word lexicon entries and the ampersand initialism keep precedence.
